title: Farm Quest
author: Thomas Nettle
description:
It's a pleasant morning on Hope farm. You've woken up and had your morning breakfast and shower. Currently you find yourself in the farmshed with Farmer Hope himself. He's preparing to chop the head off of a chicken for his wife to prepare for lunch later on. In friendly conversation, Farmer Hope talks to you about a legend of there being a treasure hidden somewhere on the farm from a previous generation. As farmer Hope is about to kill a hen for lunch the hen laughs to itself. Miraculously you discover that you actually understood the hen.
